stories.label: Iran war Day 17: Araghchi rejects talks; IRGC strikes US bases in Kuwait/Bahrain; Iran threatens economic targets
stories.summary: Day 17. Araghchi explicitly rejected Trump's peace signal — the 'de-escalation hopes' that crashed oil 15% last cycle were built on a false signal. IRGC confirmed striking US base infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain. Iran escalated to threatening economic targets: banks and financial centres across the Gulf, warning people to stay 1km from banks. Israel privately admitted no certainty the war will produce regime change. The war is expanding from military to economic warfare.

stories.label: Hormuz economic fallout: airlines fares double; UK mortgages hit; Pakistan austerity; Russian billionaires record
stories.summary: Jet fuel nearly doubled ($85-90 → $150-200/barrel); Qantas, SAS, Air New Zealand raising fares; Singapore Airlines Dubai suspension extended to March 28. UK mortgage rates hit highest since August — Iran war transmitting through oil → inflation → gilt yields → household mortgage costs. Pakistan declared 4-day work week, closed schools for 3+ weeks, 50% fuel cut — 240M people on wartime austerity caused by a war they are not fighting. Araghchi's rejection of talks means oil rebound from the false 'de-escalation hopes' signal is now likely.

stories.label: Lebanon: Israeli strikes across Beirut, 700K+ displaced; France UNSC resolution outcome unknown
stories.summary: Israeli strikes across Lebanon on Wednesday including central Beirut (second time the capital's centre has been targeted). 700,000+ total displaced; 394 killed in one week including 83 children. White phosphorus confirmed in populated areas (HRW). Lebanon delayed elections two years. France's UNSC emergency session outcome still unknown — US veto likely but unconfirmed. Not selected this cycle — decayed from 9.

stories.label: Israel privately admits no certainty Iran government will fall despite war
stories.summary: Reuters obtained internal Israeli acknowledgment that there is 'no certainty' the war will produce regime change in Iran. Mojtaba Khamenei appears to be consolidating rather than fracturing. This is the war's stated justification — and Israel is privately conceding it may fail. Major accountability story: the gap between public justification and private doubt, while thousands die.

stories.label: Spain removes ambassador to Israel — first EU/NATO state diplomatic downgrade
stories.summary: Spain formally removed its ambassador to Israel, published in the official state gazette. Embassy will be led by a chargé d'affaires. First EU/NATO state to formally downgrade diplomatic relations. Spain has been the most resistant EU state throughout the conflict — blocking US bases, defying Trump's trade threats. Watch for Belgium, Ireland, or France following.

stories.label: UK Home Secretary (Muslim) bans pro-Palestine Al-Quds Day march — civil rights under wartime
stories.summary: Shabana Mahmood, UK Home Secretary (first Muslim woman in the role, British-Pakistani) approved police request to ban the annual Al-Quds Day pro-Palestine march in London — citing 'threats to public disorder.' The march has taken place for 40 years. Connects to anti-Muslim-hate arc: state suppression of political expression from the Muslim community during wartime.

stories.label: Anti-Muslim hate arc: platform amplification → media bias → CAIR report → lawmaker posts → state ban on protest
stories.summary: Five-part arc: X algorithm amplification (data) → UK media 50% bias study (institutional) → CAIR report (structural) → US lawmaker posts (political accountability) → UK state bans pro-Palestine march (state suppression). The Al-Quds ban completes the arc from algorithmic to institutional to state suppression of Muslim political speech during wartime. Watch for legal challenge to the ban, advertiser pressure on platforms, or Congressional discipline.

stories.label: Rheinmetall calls war an 'opportunity' — defence industry boom from Iran conflict
stories.summary: Rheinmetall (Germany's largest arms maker) publicly described the Middle East war as a 'business opportunity' and forecast continued strong growth from air defence system contracts. Watch for other European defence contractors (BAE Systems, Leonardo, Thales) making similar declarations and for parliamentary scrutiny of war profiteering in EU states.

stories.label: Record 155 Russian billionaires on Forbes list — fourth consecutive year of growth despite war and sanctions
stories.summary: 155 Russians on Forbes billionaires list — a record, fourth consecutive year of growth. Western sanctions as a pressure mechanism to change oligarch behaviour has empirically failed. Wealth is largely domestic (real estate, commodities, bank stakes) and held offshore in UAE, Turkey, China — beyond Western reach.

stories.label: UK coal at 400-year low; emissions fall 2.4% in 2025 — pre-industrial energy milestone
stories.summary: UK coal consumption at lowest level in 400 years (pre-Industrial Revolution). Total emissions fell 2.4% in 2025. Solar and wind capacity has reached scale where coal is only dispatched in grid emergencies. Significant milestone arriving under near-total media blackout due to Iran war coverage.

stories.label: China five-year climate goals: Paris compatibility analysis from Carbon Brief
stories.summary: China's five-year climate plan (2026-2030) now has Carbon Brief's independent scientific analysis: what do the specific targets mean for Paris temperature goals? Coverage now moves from government announcement to scientific verification. Arc: announcing → verifying → policy consequences.

stories.label: Chinese PLA-affiliated firm claims to have intercepted B-2 stealth bomber radio signal during Iran strike
stories.summary: Jingan Technology (PLA intelligence contractor) claims to have intercepted B-2 Spirit stealth bomber radio signals during March 1 Iran strikes. If genuine: US stealth doctrine assumes invisibility; this changes calculations across Taiwan Strait, Korean peninsula, and Gulf. Watch for US DoD denial or silence, and for independent signals intelligence community verification.

stories.label: AI in warfare: China names 'Terminator' risk; disinformation, autonomous failures, infrastructure rollbacks
stories.summary: China formally warned the US that unconditional military AI use risks autonomous weapons spiralling beyond control — the first state-level diplomatic articulation of the autonomous weapons risk in this conflict. Arc encompasses: AI-guided strikes (capability questions), AI disinformation (fake satellite imagery, paid unlabelled footage), Amazon's human oversight mandate, and now China's 'Terminator' warning. Watch for multilateral AI arms control proposal or UN response.

stories.label: Mastercard + 85 partners (Binance, PayPal, Ripple) building blockchain payment infrastructure
stories.summary: Mastercard has assembled 85+ partners to connect on-chain payments with conventional banking infrastructure. 85 partners signals infrastructure buildout, not pilot. Who loses: correspondent banks, SWIFT. Who gains: remittance senders, small businesses doing international trade. Settlement times collapse from days to seconds.

stories.label: Trump reportedly plans to seize Iran's Kharg Island oil terminal
stories.summary: Trump reportedly reviving 1986 Kharg Island seizure plan. No State Dept or NSC confirmation. Decayed from 7.

stories.label: US commanders told troops Trump 'anointed by Jesus'; Democrats demand investigation
stories.summary: Democrats demanding investigation into commanders framing war as biblical prophecy. Decayed from 6.

stories.label: North Korea sea-launches cruise missile from destroyer under Iran war cover
stories.summary: First sea-launched strategic cruise missile from surface vessel. Not covered three consecutive cycles — fading.

stories.label: Boeing $289M contract: 5,000 smart bombs for Israel during active war
stories.summary: Boeing $289M for 5,000 smart bombs to Israel. Second major arms deal in four days. Not covered three cycles — fading.

stories.label: Amazon mandates human sign-off on AI-assisted code after infrastructure outages
stories.summary: First institutional rollback of AI autonomy in critical infrastructure. Absorbed into ai-in-warfare-iran arc. Not covered three cycles — fading.

stories.label: Ukraine: Turkey trilateral peace process stalled
stories.summary: Turkey as trilateral host confirmed. Frontline grinding continues. Four consecutive cycles uncovered — fading. Iran war has completely dominated coverage.

stories.label: Iranian missiles mapping NATO's Kürecik radar — Article 5 stakes
stories.summary: Iranian missiles mapping Kürecik NATO radar gaps. NATO rushed Patriots to defend. Not covered three consecutive cycles — fading.

stories.label: Darfur: RSF destroys farms before mass killings — starvation crimes evidence
stories.summary: Forensic evidence of RSF deliberately destroying farms before mass killings. Not in current feed — decayed from 6. Watch AllAfrica, France 24, Premium Times. Sudan comprehensively overshadowed by Iran war.

stories.label: Chile: Kast inaugurated; Lula boycott; Machado-Milei-Kast right bloc forming
stories.summary: Far-right Kast inaugurated. Kast-Milei-Machado axis taking visible shape. Decayed from 6. Watch for first policy actions: migration crackdowns, trade positions, alignment against Cuba/Venezuela.

stories.label: Hajj 2026: Indonesia formalises contingency planning as war continues toward pilgrimage season
stories.summary: Indonesia (world's largest Hajj delegation) formally preparing contingencies. 1.8 billion Muslims' sacred obligation is now a logistics question. Hajj begins late May 2026 — window is narrowing fast. Decayed from 7. Next key signal: Saudi Arabia's own public statement.

stories.label: Saudi Petroline East-West pipeline: Riyadh gains structural leverage as bypasses remain unequal
stories.summary: Saudi Petroline (4.8 mb/d) mobilised to bypass Hormuz. Iraq and Kuwait have no bypass. UAE has Abu Dhabi pipeline (~1.5 mb/d, insufficient). Decayed from 7.

stories.label: China's YJ-12 supersonic anti-ship missiles: what if Iran acquired them?
stories.summary: YJ-12 (Mach 2-3) reportedly close to export sale to Iran before strikes. Supersonic halves Aegis interception window. Decayed from 7. B-2 intercept story this cycle suggests China's intelligence involvement in the conflict is broader than previously assessed.

stories.label: Yann LeCun raises $1B to build world-model AI — scientific challenge to LLM paradigm
stories.summary: Turing Award winner LeCun raising $1B to build AI that learns predictive models of the physical world — arguing LLMs cannot achieve general intelligence. Decayed from 7.

stories.label: South Korea-UAE AI cooperation signalled for post-war acceleration; Gulf tech hub planning
stories.summary: South Korea's presidential aide signals UAE-Korea AI cooperation will accelerate after conflict. UAE's G42 (royal family-owned) is the largest Gulf AI investor. Decayed from 6.

stories.label: Geely beats BYD in China for first 2 months of 2026 — EV competition shifting
stories.summary: Geely overtook BYD in China's domestic auto market in January-February 2026. BYD's export push may be creating domestic focus gaps. Decayed from 6.

stories.label: Applied category theory ('green math') — abstract mathematics for optimising real-world systems
stories.summary: Applied category theory reframed as 'green math' — framework for optimising how systems interact, from supply chains to climate models. Math so abstract it has no numbers or equations, yet claimed to be practically useful for reducing systemic waste.

stories.label: Gaza: Siege continues — total media blackout now 9+ cycles
stories.summary: WHO warned medical supplies exhausted. No feed items for 9+ cycles. Total blackout under Iran war coverage. Kept as reminder of what is not being reported. Cannot be pruned.

stories.label: Bristol floating wind turbine and Europe's clean energy urgency under Iran war
stories.summary: Bristol floating offshore wind — newly urgent as Gulf oil dependency costs rise. Decayed from 5. Now partially superseded by UK coal 400-year-low story (broader milestone). Fading.

stories.label: Presolar crystals in meteorites reveal the solar system's formation from dead stars
stories.summary: Quanta Magazine feature on pre-solar grains. Published. Decayed from 5. Fading — no follow-up expected.
